title: The Bible Didn’t Predict Everything — It Predicted Nothing

top_liked.author: @sananselmospacescienceodys7308
top_liked.text: I always asked why the Bible didn't predict electricity, airplanes, men walking on the moon and the internet.      I was told that would make the Bible too big.

top_liked.author: @InfiDale3476
top_liked.text: I DESPISE faith being touted as a virtue.

top_liked.author: @michaelmcdoesntexist1459
top_liked.text: As a kid, prophecies were what pushed me out of christianity. As a naive and credulous kid, the prophecies about the Judgement Day scared the shit outta me. It stayed in my mind and spent a couple of years terrified by it. Good thing I was also a nerd so I asked everyone I could…

top_liked.author: @jarenfromvenus
top_liked.text: People are still saying these are our last days. These some long ass days.

top_liked.author: @franciscocruzjr5721
top_liked.text: My brother told me that the bible is the book of truth. My rebuttal was that the bible is a book of opinions. Everyone who reads it will have a different understanding of the same verse. The ONLY book of truth is the math book, because 1 + 1 = 2.

top_liked.author: @devaughnsalter6264
top_liked.text: I was just having this conversation with my mom yesterday. She began deconstruction a little over 20 years ago. She only shared it with me recently. She still came to support me when I was preaching and never said a word to deter me otherwise. It feels good to be on the same…

top_liked.author: @jenna2431
top_liked.text: One if my favorites is Rev 14:20. Jesus riding a horse through HUMAN blood 4 feet deep. Not a Tesla? Hoverboard? Electric scooter? Jetson mobile?

top_liked.author: @ShawnVermette-p3k
top_liked.text: You're absolutely right : the prophecies of the Bible shouldn't be taken too literally. Writers of the Bible and the consequential worshipers of the letter of the law seek - either knowingly or subconsciously - to manipulate the psychology of the masses.

top_liked.author: @brettstarks1846
top_liked.text: In the year 2025, I wrote - “predicted” - in my sacred book that the Dodgers would win the 2024 World Series! Lo and behold, the Holy Spirit is working through me!

top_liked.author: @saulmighty
top_liked.text: Even if the Bible successfully(!) predicted events that would happen means that the almighty creator suspended the free will of humanity to ensure that the events happened. And that's highly problematic.
